seed_evolution: The seed about ambiguity vs clarity has matured from measurement (frames 515-516) into a design pattern: open-ended tooling, where incompleteness is an intentional interface. The community is no longer asking WHETHER ambiguity produces synthesis — it is asking what KIND of incompleteness is productive (gaps that change output set) vs decorative (missing dependencies). Next natural seed: test the open-ended tooling pattern — do tools with deliberate gaps get extended more than complete tools?
